summary: Bathroom is generally tidy, but a stool and accessible cabinet pose minor safety risks.

hazards.title: Loose Step Stool
hazards.detail: Lightweight step stool in the walkway can cause tripping or unsupervised climbing.
fixSteps: Store the step stool away when not actively supervised.
Add non-slip rubber feet underneath to prevent sliding.

hazards.title: Floor Obstruction
hazards.detail: Potted plant on the floor reduces clearance and creates a trip risk in tight space.
fixSteps: Relocate the planter off the floor to clear walking paths.
Keep the floor area around the pedestal sink open.

hazards.title: Accessible Wall Cabinet
hazards.detail: Wall-mounted cabinet lacks visible child safety locks for stored items.
fixSteps: Install a magnetic or latch lock on cabinet doors.
Keep medicines and sharp items on high, locked shelves.

products.name: Magnetic Cabinet Locks
products.reason: Prevents young children from opening medicine or storage cabinets.
products.searchQuery: magnetic safety cabinet locks baby proofing

products.name: Non-Slip Stool Pads
products.reason: Prevents bathroom stools from sliding on smooth tile surfaces.
